poses.caption: Hold the suspension handles and lean back with arms extended, keeping the body straight.
Bend both elbows to curl your body toward the handles while keeping upper arms steady; lower with control.

BOTH arms curl symmetrically, not row elbows behind body or chin-up. Same fixed length straps taut, unchanged fixed anchor and foot placement, hands never pass behind head. Primary BOTH exposed BICEPS RED only no chest red. Whole anchor/frame/body/feet/hands inside EACH cell generous white margins. Fine premium ADULT male detailed grayscale exposed anatomical muscle contours realistic proportions fingers/equipment, equal male/female detail. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows generous margins entire body and apparatus within frame. Full opaque BLACK athletic tank and MID-THIGH shorts wrapping FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH continuous seams and broad fabric folds no transparency/cutaway/anatomical fibers through cloth.
